original_test_intent: Verify a powered-on OS remains stable while idle for 24 hours at 40C/-5% rail margin.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Disable hibernate, leave the system idle for 24 hours, then collect BMC and OS evidence.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: No disallowed BMC/system log event, hang, or blue screen.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY, but marked the 24-hour procedure versus 720-minute Machine Time as SOURCE_CONFLICT.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator controls the chamber and rails; liveness and log collection can be automated during the idle soak.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 40C/-5% rails and 24-hour idle soak; 720-minute Machine Time is a planning estimate.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Idle/sleep definition, allowed monitoring, power-setting change, liveness cadence, event allowlist and override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A 12-hour project run is complete only for that override and leaves a 12-hour Master gap.

original_method: The 24-hour idle and hibernate-disable steps remain visible.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the project's existing idle-soak monitor to timestamp liveness, uptime, power state and error-log deltas without adding stress load.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Target OS and platform power-management stack.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable OS power-management and platform event-log documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds nonintrusive continuous evidence and restoration of settings.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Still requires the full approved idle duration.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Power policy, monitoring cadence and event allowlist.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Monitoring must not convert idle into a stress workload.

missing_inputs: Original power policy and event allowlist
safety_boundaries: Do not leave power settings changed
Stop on fixture safety limit or loss of control
no_automatic_retry: A crash or missed interval is preserved; no automatic soak restart.
engineer_owned_verdict: System/margin engineer determines whether observed events are acceptable.
review_improvement: Removes a Machine Time-only blocker and explicitly records how an approved 12-hour run differs from the 24-hour Master requirement.
